text:
jordan: Noticing a ~2.7x per-tenant cost multiplier after we broadened preflight sampling. heatmap spike at 00:40 UTC.
lee: Which sampling change? thought we only bumped tiny clients.
jordan: telemetry.preflight.sample_rate 0.4% -> 3% last night. correlated with splitter_invocations.
yasmin: Expected: more preflights -> more mixed-dim detection -> splitter multiplies internal RPCs.
pm-ash: CS needs a one-line explainer for affected customers. quick mitigation?
lee: Short-term: revert sampling for trial and free tiers to 0.5% and keep prod canary. will flip now.
telemetry-bot: config toggle applied (job id: 7310). monitoring window started.
telemetry-bot: post-change: splitter invocations down ~52%, cost delta reduced ~37% vs peak.
jordan: Good. Long-term: propose a cheap preflight-estimator API so ingress can predict "will this split" without causing multipliers.
yasmin: API sketch:
POST /v1/embeddings/preflight/estimate
{ "n": 100, "avg_bytes": 1200, "dims_hint": [512] }
-> { "est_units": 1420, "prob_split": 0.68, "est_confidence": 0.8, "recommended_action": "reduce_batch" }
lee: Console UX: show est_units in preview, yellow "may fragment" badge when prob_split > 0.5, and annotate cost charts when sampling config changes. PM wants banner for 24h.
pm-ash: Also add a billing note during canary. don't surprise finance.
yasmin: Telemetry: persist estimator_id and sample predictions at 1% to compute accuracy; storage impact ~+10% monthly. I'll file obs ticket.
jordan: Routing: ingress calls estimator; if prob_split low route fastpath; else route to splitter or suggest client-side backoff. add header X-Estimator-Id for traces.
lee: Automation: add auto-revert rule: if splitter_amplification > 2.0 within 2h of config change, revert sample-rate. create alert id A-8112.
telemetry-bot: alert rule A-8112 created.
yasmin: Action items: YASMIN -> obs ticket + estimator telemetry fields; LEE -> API PR + perf bench (p95 <5ms); JORDAN -> console mocks + billing banner; PM-ASH -> customer note template.
jordan: Will include estimator accuracy dashboard in console and conservative bias toggle per-tenant. keep estimator conservative by default.
lee: I'll draft PR and run microbench with synthetic mixed-dim sets. tagging reviewers.
pm-ash: Thanks team. update incident doc and ping CS. :thumbsup:
